svg.title: Pundoku mark — D3 «Капля»
svg.desc: One closed curve through six radii (290/225/262/238/282/243 at 0/60/120/180/240/300 degrees around 496,530), Catmull-Rom converted to cubics, then scaled 1.3 about the canvas centre. One satellite droplet at (650,185) r=42. Not a cartoon splat: no spikes, no tendrils, every tangent continuous.
